**Named for the rule rather than for the fish**, so it is a seam a pack can use: anything that ought to
belong at depth goes in here without touching the jar, and the abyss gains a population over time.
**Guardians are in it so a monument standing in the abyss is still a monument** (Jonah, 2026-09-10).
The alternative was a structure that emptied itself of everything that made it worth entering, which
is the abyss taking away a fight rather than adding one.
Everything absent from it takes the pressure -- a drowned, a squid, anything that wandered down. An
abyss that only hurt players would be scenery with a damage tick on it rather than somewhere hostile.
**Every member of this tag is exempt on its own account only, and shelters nobody.** `DeepWater.press`
reads the tag off the body being pressed and never off what that body is riding, so a saddled nautilus
swims the abyss unharmed while whoever rides it is pressed exactly as if swimming. Passing the mount's
exemption through to its rider made the saddle a better suit than the suit, which is the one thing the
ladder in design 7.1.2 cannot afford. The nautilus is still here because it lives there, and the zombie
